HAL_2016_p39__paragraph_0.ocr:
Crude oil prices have been extremely volatile during the past few years. WTI oil spot prices declined significantly 
towards the second half of 2014 with a peak price of $108 per barrel in June 2014, and continued to decline throughout 2015, 
ranging from a high of $61 per barrel to a low of $35 per barrel. WTI oil spot prices declined further into February 2016 to a 
low of $26 per barrel, a level which had not been experienced since 2003. Brent crude oil spot prices declined from a high of 
$115 per barrel in June 2014, and continued to decline throughout 2015, ranging from a high of $66 per barrel to a low of $35 
per barrel, and declined further to $26 per barrel in January 2016. Commodity prices have increased from the low point 
experienced in early 2016 to highs of $54 per barrel in December 2016 for WTI and $55 per barrel in December 2016 for Brent.
